safety: Flexionar las rodillas y mantener el rebote

steps_taught.name: Chaquitinkuy
steps_taught.description: A basic Huaylarsh step involving a double foot strike and a cross-over motion.

what_works: Separate segments for men and women

quotes.text: En primer lugar vamos a flexionar las rodillas y mantener el rebote.
Ahora vamos a probar cruzando uno delante del otro.
Y ahora le vamos a agregar una jaladita para atrás.
Siempre con los codos activos, muy importante detalle.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher performs a rhythmic, bouncy step with a skirt, moving her torso side to side.
The teacher demonstrates the basic footwork by lifting each foot twice in a rhythmic pattern.
The teacher demonstrates how to hold and move the skirt while performing the footwork.
The teacher demonstrates arm positions for men by crossing hands behind the back.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher explicitly separates the lesson into gender-specific styling (skirt work for women, arm work for men) after teaching the core footwork.
